headline: Skipper Program and contracts with Via Transportation Inc., DBA River North Transit, LLC. Of NY for an on demand rideshare program.
summary: The meeting will cover the Skipper Program. It will also cover any contracts with Via Transportation Inc., DBA River North Transit, LLC. Of NY for an on demand rideshare program.

MEETING NOTICE AND AGENDA 
 
The City Council Committee on Administration and Finance co-posted with the 
Committee of the Whole will meet in person on Thursday November 12, 2026, at 6:00 
PM for the purpose of discussing Skipper Program and any contracts with Via 
Transportation Inc., DBA River North Transit, LLC. Of NY for an on demand rideshare 
program.   
 
This meeting will be held in the City Council Chambers. 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 
2nd Floor.
